# `serviceNotAsClass`

Warns when Context.Service is used as a variable instead of a class declaration

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `off` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377056` |
| Language Service name | `serviceNotAsClass` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/service-not-as-class` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Context } from "effect"

export const Preview = Context.Service<{ port: number }>("Preview")
/**
                       ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(service-not-as-class): `Context.Service` is assigned to a variable here, but this API is intended for a class declaration shape such as `class Preview extends Context.Service<Preview, { port: number }>()("Preview") {}`.
*/
```
